turns.sql:
SELECT p.product_category_code,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue_euros
FROM Complaints c
JOIN Products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.date_complaint_raised >= date((SELECT MAX(date_complaint_raised) FROM Complaints), '-1 year')
GROUP BY p.product_category_code
ORDER BY total_revenue_euros DESC;
